status: FINAL. Supersedes the earlier approved packages and the experimental no-duration / zero-pad packages.
filter_order: 7. packets from the first 8 seconds only (elapsed <= D, before slotting)
short_flows: NOT admitted; terminal zero-padding is NOT used
empty_slots: empty slots inside a retained flow occur naturally and are all-zero

VPN.statement: Every VNAT VPN flow is OpenVPN over UDP, so TCP-only removes all 79 of them. This package contains NO VPN traffic. Do not claim that VPN and non-VPN are both represented.

split_stratified_on: traffic class only (never VPN status, never application identity)
split_derivation: TCP-only subset of the ORIGINAL frozen per-duration split (fingerprint 68727548861bb3d8, 2080 flows); non-TCP flows dropped from the side they were already on; no retained flow changed side; the split was NOT regenerated from a seed
aggregation: none (flow-level metrics; no UTMobile capture aggregation)
class_weight_formula: w_c = n_train / (4 * train_count_c), TRAIN LABELS ONLY
grad_clip_rationale: VNAT-specific. Pre-clip gradient norms exceed 1.0 on 92.5-100% of steps for 10 of 12 diagnostic cells; a paired ON/OFF pilot gave clipping the higher validation macro-F1 in 6 of 6 pairs (mean +2.10) and halved the seed spread at 250ms.

early_stopping.gate: counter starts only once the LR has reached min_lr

standardization: per-feature over axis (0,1), fitted on TRAIN rows only
self_contained: no symlinks; no executable, import or runtime reference to any superseded package, pilot or report directory
supersedes: the earlier approved weighted/deterministic VNAT packages (3s, 5s, 8s)
the experimental TCP-only no-duration zero-padded VNAT packages (3s, 5s, 8s)
supersedes_note: Directory names of superseded work are recorded ONLY in the deletion manifest under the reproduction directory, never here and never in code.
split_note: The only change versus the previous approved VNAT protocol is TCP-only. The Train/Validation membership is therefore inherited from that protocol.
